sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct can help users fix errors in their code, making programming more efficient. Aider is a popular benchmark for code repair, and Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct scored 73.7, performing comparably to GPT-4o on Aider.

sources.title: qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q8_0
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, a range of base language models and instruction-tuned models are released, with sizes ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.
